integration: Separate partial Pipe limit evidence. Reuse source and incidence from identical inputs; expose distanceOne/Two availability and explicit auxiliary source-start vertex provenance only. Never clear full Pipe tool failures or populate Path opposition/partial curve.

SDK_evidence.PipeFeature.distanceTwo: The installed getter contract returns null for an open path and a reverse-path distance for a closed path. Availability follows independently resolved single-edge closure, not optional selector presence.
SDK_evidence.PipeFeatureInput.distanceOne_distanceTwo: Input distances are fractions in[0,1]. Closed-path distanceOne+distanceTwo may not exceed1; open-path distanceTwo setting is ignored.
SDK_evidence.PipeFeature.path: Starting point is the starting point of the first path curve. This documents an API role but does not decode stored Path opposition from the current all-unopposed captures.

grammar.distance_roles: Existing owned typed native bindings AgainstDistance@13 and AlongDistance@24 retain their model-parameter roles. AgainstDistance matches API distanceOne across contrasted full/partial open/closed cases. AlongDistance is active API distanceTwo only on the independently resolved closed single source edge, otherwise an inactive duplicate of AgainstDistance.
grammar.auxiliary_vertex: Observed40-byte vertex_recipe_data: int32 -1,uint32 count3,three (name index,int32 -1) pairs,two int32zeros. All three complete name tuples map uniquely into the source edge recipe, in exactly the same operand order as its start-vertex subrecipe. The already validated reciprocal incidence supplies the vertex identity.
grammar.context_copy: Explicit owned context edge recipe repeats full source name table and every payload byte except final int32: source0,context-1. This invariant is retained without direction/limit semantics.

limitations: All six saved PathEntity.isOpposedToEntity getters are false; the corpus has no native true/false contrast. Stored auxiliary source-start identity does not establish a universal Path opposition flag.
Descriptor flag1 occurs for both open negative Line and closed Circle while all API opposition flags stay false. No closedness or Path opposition is assigned to that byte.
Circular92-byte recipe tail remains opaque. Its primary/context last-field0/-1 distinction is invariant across full/partial cases and cannot encode those active limits by itself.
Actual PathEntity.curve is the full input geometry even when Pipe distanceOne/Two are partial. Its full length/domain is not the resulting Pipe path extent.

Only independently resolved captured single source Line/Circle, solid circular NewBody, root-component identity-transform cases are admitted. Multi-edge paths, opposed cases, arcs, non-circular curves, occurrence transforms and full Pipe tool regeneration remain unresolved.
